classical_optimum.method: brute force over all C(10,6)=210 subsets

presolve.justification: Mathematical Proof: Over all C(10,6)=210 candidate subsets, the maximum contact cost is 15.0 <= 25.0 and the maximum capacity is 19.0 <= 22.0. Both linear inequality constraints are provably non-binding. Therefore, all 9 auxiliary slack qubits (5 for budget, 4 for capacity) and inequality penalty terms B can be rigorously eliminated at runtime, simplifying the problem to an exact 10-qubit QUBO with cardinality constraint A only.

final_selection.source: best feasible bitstring among 10,000 measured shots of the optimized QAOA circuit (presolve-justified 10-qubit formulation and full 19-qubit benchmark)

environment_note: NumPy statevector simulation (no quantum SDK available at development time); Qiskit port in qiskit_port/
